name: terminal-notify
description: Desktop notifications through your terminal when Claude Code finishes, asks a question or needs a permission. From the makers of Agent Terminal (https://4nuva.dev/agent-terminal/), which also forwards them to your phone.

format.title: Notification sequence
format.description: auto picks one for your terminal. osc777: Agent Terminal, Ghostty, Warp, urxvt. osc9: Windows Terminal, iTerm2, WezTerm, ConEmu. osc99: kitty. all: all three, for a terminal auto does not know (one that reads several shows several). bell: the terminal bell only. off: no notifications.

details.title: Show details
details.description: Include the start of Claude's reply, the command or file a permission is for, and the question. Off shows only the event. Known key and token formats are masked either way.

idle_reminder.title: Idle reminder
idle_reminder.description: Notify again when the prompt has waited 60 seconds for a reply.
